def method_audit(event,args):
    if event=="import":
        audit_refuse("new-phase import")
    if event in ("mmap.__new__","sys.addaudithook","sys.settrace","os.chdir","os.putenv","os.unsetenv"):
        audit_refuse("new-phase effect")
    if event=="compile":
        METHOD_COUNTS["compile_audit"]+=1

    if event=="exec":
        METHOD_COUNTS["exec_audit"]+=1
        if not (CURRENT=="method-freeze" and METHOD_EXEC_ACTIVE and METHOD_COUNTS["exec"]==METHOD_COUNTS["exec_audit"]==1 and len(args)==1 and args[0] is METHOD_CODE):
            audit_refuse("method execution event")
    if event=="fcntl.fcntl":

            audit_refuse("new-phase open shape")
        name,mode,flags=args
        if CURRENT=="method-freeze" and type(name) is int and name==METHOD_FD and mode=="r" and type(flags) is int and not flags & (os.O_WRONLY|os.O_RDWR|os.O_CREAT|os.O_TRUNC|os.O_APPEND) and PIPE_OPENS==1 and METHOD_COUNTS["pipe_open_audit"]==0:
            METHOD_COUNTS["pipe_open_audit"]+=1

            METHOD_COUNTS["private_open_audit"]+=1
            return True
        audit_refuse("unexpected new-phase open")
    return False

def schema_check(value,schema,depth=0,budget=None):
    if budget is None:budget=[0]
    budget[0]+=1
    require(depth<=16 and budget[0]<=32768 and type(schema) is dict,"result schema bound")
    kind=schema.get("t")
    if kind=="object":
        require(type(value) is dict and set(value)==set(schema["fields"]),"result object")
        for key,child in schema["fields"].items():schema_check(value[key],child,depth+1,budget)
    elif kind=="array":
        require(type(value) is list and schema["min"]<=len(value)<=schema["max"],"result array")
        for child in value:schema_check(child,schema["items"],depth+1,budget)
    elif kind=="map":
        require(type(value) is dict and set(value)<=set(schema["keys"]),"result map")
        for child in value.values():schema_check(child,schema["values"],depth+1,budget)
    elif kind=="nullable":
        if value is not None:schema_check(value,schema["item"],depth+1,budget)
    elif kind=="enum":
        require(any(type(value) is type(item) and value==item for item in schema["values"]),"result enum")
    elif kind=="bool":
        require(type(value) is bool,"result boolean")
    elif kind=="int":
        require(type(value) is int and schema["min"]<=value<=schema["max"],"result integer")
    elif kind=="int64":
        require(type(value) is int and -(1<<63)<=value<(1<<63),"result signed integer")
    elif kind in ("address","sha256","git-sha","name","call-id"):
        patterns={"address":r"0x[0-9a-f]{1,16}","sha256":r"[0-9a-f]{64}","git-sha":r"[0-9a-f]{40}","name":r"[A-Za-z0-9_.@$-]{1,512}","call-id":r"call-[0-9]{1,2}"}
        require(type(value) is str and re.fullmatch(patterns[kind],value) is not None,"result string")
    else:
        fail("result-schema-kind")
